sources.recommend_reason_zh: LFM2.5-24B-A2B 用 24B 参数、2B 激活实现端侧私有 agent，支持 131K 上下文和工具调用，在 M5 Max 上解码 184 tokens/s，比次优模型快 1.7 倍。

en.reason: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-24B-A2B packs 24B parameters but activates only 2B, delivering 131K context and tool calling for on-device private agents while decoding 184 tokens/s on M5 Max, 1.7x faster than the next-best model.

sources.summary:
You can now review manual dismissals and reopenings of GitHub Code Quality findings in your organization or enterprise audit log. Findings may appear in either your repository’s default-branch backlog or…
You can now review manual dismissals and reopenings of GitHub Code Quality findings in your organization or enterprise audit log. Findings may appear in either your repository’s default-branch backlog or pull requests. Two new events record these actions:
Each event includes who made the reques
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 现可在组织或企业审计日志中查看 Code Quality 发现项的人工关闭与重新打开，两个新事件记录操作者、时间、仓库、规则及受影响发现项的数量和标识，Team 与 Enterprise Cloud 可用，Enterprise Server 不支持。

en.reason: GitHub logs manual dismissals and reopenings of Code Quality findings in organization and enterprise audit logs via two new events capturing actor, timestamp, repository, rule, plus affected findings' count and identifiers, for Team and Enterprise Cloud, not Enterprise Server.

stories.title: XBOW 团队借助 OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol 获 Google Chrome 25 万美元全链漏洞赏金 / GPT 5.6 Sol btw

sources.title: XBOW 团队借助 OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol 获 Google Chrome 25 万美元全链漏洞赏金 / GPT 5.6 Sol btw
sources.title_zh: XBOW 团队借助 OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol 获 Google Chrome 25 万美元全链漏洞赏金
sources.title_en: GPT 5.6 Sol btw
sources.title_original: GPT 5.6 Sol btw
sources.summary: XBOW 团队使用 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol 辅助，在 6 天内以 4 万美元算力构建出 Chrome 全链漏洞，获得 Google 25 万美元赏金，这是 Google 第二次就 Chrome 全链漏洞发放赏金，也是 2026 年新规则下的首次。受影响范围为 Windows 上的 Chrome，作者称过去类似漏洞需约 6 个月构建，并提醒用户在出现 Update 按钮时及时重启 Chrome。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 全文仅由 GPT 5.6 Sol btw 这句话重复三次构成，没有正文、来源或任何解释，末尾只附上「查看最新动态并加入对话」，适合想弄清这个突然出现的短语究竟在说什么的人点开一看。

en.summary: The XBOW team, with help from OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, built a full-chain Chrome exploit in six days using $40,000 in compute, earning a $250,000 bounty from Google. This is Google's second bounty for a full-chain Chrome exploit and the first under new 2026 rules. Chrome on Windows is affected; the authors say similar exploits used to take about six months to build, and they remind users to restart Chrome promptly when the Update button appears.
en.reason: XBOW used OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol to build a Windows Chrome full-chain exploit in six days on $40,000 of compute, earning Google's $250,000 bounty—yet the text is only that phrase, repeated three times.

sources.title: Character.AI 成立五年后申请 Chapter 11 破产，部分资产以 2000 万美元出售给 Disney / Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
sources.title_zh: Character.AI 成立五年后申请 Chapter 11 破产，部分资产以 2000 万美元出售给 Disney
sources.title_en: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
sources.title_original: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
sources.summary: Character.AI 已申请 Chapter 11 破产，法院文件显示其资产和负债在 5000 万至 1 亿美元之间，并同意以 2000 万美元向 Disney 出售部分资产及技术非独占永久许可。出售过程预计 11 月底或 12 月初完成，期间平台继续运营，但尚无竞购方，若无买家平台将关停；此前公司因未成年用户诉讼、德州调查等困境，曾尝试 AI 视频生成、社交信息流和微短剧等转型未果。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 成立仅5年的互动聊天机器人平台 Character.AI 申请破产，并将部分资产以2000万美元出售给 Disney。

en.summary: Character.AI has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy. Court documents show assets and liabilities between $50 million and $100 million, and the company has agreed to sell select assets and a non-exclusive perpetual technology license to Disney for $20 million. The sale process is expected to close in late November or early December, with the platform remaining operational in the meantime, but no competing bidders have emerged—if no buyer is found, the platform will shut down. The company had previously struggled with lawsuits over underage users and a Texas investigation, and its attempts to pivot to AI video generation, social feeds, and short dramas failed to gain traction.
en.reason: Character.AI, the interactive chatbot platform launched just five years ago, has filed for bankruptcy and will sell some of its assets to Disney for $20 million.

sources.summary: Google 工程师用 Gemini 4 Argon 在 google/adk-python 上无人值守跑 11 小时，提出 6 项优化、审查后合并 2 项，使长会话内存会话准备时间降低约 40%，包导入加快 21%。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 值得读：Gemini 4 Argon 用 11 小时无人值守优化 ADK，把长会话内存准备时间降约 40%、冷包导入提速 21%，公开两处采用、四处评审否决。

en.summary: Google engineers ran Gemini 4 Argon unattended for 11 hours on google/adk-python, proposing 6 optimizations, 2 of which were merged after review, cutting in-memory session prep time for long sessions by about 40% and speeding up package imports by 21%.
en.reason: Google engineers ran Gemini 4 Argon unattended for 11 hours on the 200,000-line google/adk-python codebase, yielding 6 optimization proposals of which 2 were merged, cutting long-session memory preparation time about 40% and speeding package imports 21%.

sources.title_original: We discovered a sophisticated recording device that was hidden inside one of our offices. We used our models to understand the device and...
sources.summary: OpenAI 宣布在办公室内发现一个隐蔽的录音装置，利用自家模型分析该设备及其来源，确认是一名员工几天前安放。OpenAI 已将此事移交 FBI，FBI 已迅速逮捕相关人员，调查仍在进行中。OpenAI 表示目前没有迹象显示该员工不当访问或外泄模型权重、源代码或客户数据，该员工已被解雇，并将此案视为 AI 协助应对复杂安全威胁的实例。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这段内容讲述我们如何在办公室内发现被隐藏的 sophisticated recording device，用 models 溯源并锁定一名 employee 几天前放置，随后把案件移交 FBI。

en.summary: OpenAI announced that a hidden recording device was found in its office. Using its own models to analyze the device and its origins, it determined that an employee had planted it several days earlier. OpenAI has referred the matter to the FBI, which quickly arrested the individual involved; the investigation is ongoing. OpenAI said there is currently no indication that the employee improperly accessed or leaked model weights, source code, or customer data. The employee has been fired, and OpenAI is treating the case as an example of AI helping respond to complex security threats.
en.reason: OpenAI discovered a hidden recording device in its office, used its own models to trace it to an employee who planted it days earlier, and handed the case to the FBI, which arrested and fired the person.

en.summary: According to Bloomberg, Epic Games is shifting to AI-first development in its $1.5 billion partnership with Disney, with models such as Anthropic's Claude writing all the code and guiding all the art, while human developers manage and direct the generated content.
en.reason: Epic Games is reportedly moving its $1.5 billion Disney partnership to an AI-first model where Anthropic's Claude writes all code and guides all art, while a Marvel/Star Wars shooter slips from March 2027 indefinitely, with human developers guiding generated content.

sources.summary: ElevenLabs 宣布，Baroness Campbell of Surbiton 今日在英国上议院使用由其构建的 AI 重建嗓音发表演讲，为英国议会首次。Baroness 患有脊髓性肌萎缩症影响说话，AI 嗓音复刻了她原声的音调、节奏和音高。ElevenLabs 称其技术已帮助超过 11,000 名因伤病失声者恢复嗓音，并承诺帮助全球 100 万失声人群。

en.summary: ElevenLabs announced that Baroness Campbell of Surbiton today delivered a speech in the UK House of Lords using an AI-reconstructed voice built by the company, a first for the UK Parliament. The Baroness has spinal muscular atrophy, which affects her speech, and the AI voice replicated the tone, rhythm and pitch of her original voice. ElevenLabs says its technology has helped more than 11,000 people who lost their voice to injury or illness restore it, and has pledged to help 1 million people worldwide who have lost their voices.
en.reason: Baroness Campbell of Surbiton spoke in the UK Parliament's House of Lords using an ElevenLabs AI recreation of her voice—a first—which replicated her tone, rhythm and pitch despite spinal muscular atrophy; ElevenLabs says it helped over 11,000.

primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: Baroness Campbell of Surbiton 因 spinal muscular atrophy 影响 speech，在 @UKHouseofLords 用 ElevenLabs 打造的 AI 复刻声音发表演讲，成为 UK Parliament 首次此类案例；这篇内容值得读来了解她如何用 AI 复刻自己的声音参与议事。

en.summary: ElevenLabs announced that Baroness Campbell of Surbiton today delivered a speech in the UK House of Lords using an AI-reconstructed voice built by the company, a first for the UK Parliament. The Baroness has spinal muscular atrophy, which affects her speech, and the AI voice replicated the tone, rhythm and pitch of her original voice. ElevenLabs says its technology has helped more than 11,000 people who lost their voice to injury or illness restore it, and has pledged to help 1 million people worldwide who have lost their voices.
en.reason: Baroness Campbell of Surbiton spoke in the UK Parliament's House of Lords using an ElevenLabs AI recreation of her voice—a first—which replicated her tone, rhythm and pitch despite spinal muscular atrophy; ElevenLabs says it helped over 11,000.

en.title: Apple quietly acqui-hires AI podcast team: reverse-hiring Huxe sets the stage for Podcasts personalization
en.reason: Apple told the European Commission it reverse acqui-hired Huxe's core team, offered jobs to Huxe AI staff and secured a non-exclusive IP license, after Huxe, whose founder built NotebookLM's AI-generated podcast, shut down May 21, hinting at Apple Podcasts personalization.

en.summary: Anthropic published an engineering retrospective: with Claude driving average daily merged code volume from about 2,500 in May 2026 to over 30,000 by September, it built its own version control system Scion in five months, fully replacing git, and launched code review tool Antique.

en.title: From model capabilities to safety boundaries, ByteDance Seed forms new department to tackle frontier AI risks.
en.reason: ByteDance Seed has created a Model-Alignment & Preparedness department led by Yan Lin, reporting to Wu Yonghui, absorbing Responsible AI and parts of the Chat team to address Agent Models and CBRN risks through safety evaluation, alignment training and monitoring.

stories.title: 面壁智能开源 MiniCPM-V 4.7，35B-A3B MoE 模型 3GB 内存端侧流畅运行

sources.title: 面壁智能开源 MiniCPM-V 4.7，35B-A3B MoE 模型 3GB 内存端侧流畅运行
sources.title_zh: 面壁智能开源 MiniCPM-V 4.7，35B-A3B MoE 模型 3GB 内存端侧流畅运行
sources.title_original: 面壁智能开源 MiniCPM-V 4.7，35B-A3B MoE 模型 3GB 内存端侧流畅运行
sources.summary: 面壁智能联合 OpenBMB 社区于10月13日发布并开源 MiniCPM-V 4.7，包含 35B-A3B 和 1B 两个版本，称其为全球首个可在端侧无损流畅运行的开源 MoE 多模态大模型。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 面壁智能开源 MiniCPM-V 4.7，采用 35B-A3B MoE 架构，仅需 3GB 内存即可在端侧流畅运行，关注小内存设备本地跑大模型部署方案的读者值得一读。

en.title: ModelBest open-sources MiniCPM-V 4.7, a 35B-A3B MoE model that runs smoothly on-device with 3GB of memory
en.summary: ModelBest, together with the OpenBMB community, released and open-sourced MiniCPM-V 4.7 on October 13, comprising two versions, 35B-A3B and 1B, which it calls the world's first open-source MoE multimodal large model capable of running losslessly and smoothly on edge devices.
en.reason: ModelBest and the OpenBMB community open-sourced MiniCPM-V 4.7 on October 13, a 35B-A3B MoE multimodal model in 1B and 35B-A3B versions that runs on-device with only 3GB memory.

sources.title_original: 3 个月烧掉 5000 亿 Token，AI 把《现代战争 2》源代码"复刻"了 83%

stories.title: Pydantic AI 创始人 Samuel Colvin：图库是个错误，代码本身就是图 / The code is the graph

sources.title: Pydantic AI 创始人 Samuel Colvin：图库是个错误，代码本身就是图 / The code is the graph
sources.title_zh: Pydantic AI 创始人 Samuel Colvin：图库是个错误，代码本身就是图
sources.title_en: The code is the graph
sources.title_original: The code is the graph
sources.summary: Pydantic AI 创始人 Samuel Colvin 发文认为图库是个错误，代码本身就是图，通过类型提示获得类型安全、通过 async 获得并行执行。他提出图 API 存在类似 CAP 定理的取舍，类型安全、并行与快照三者不可兼得，并以此解释为何在 pydantic-graph V2 移除持久化、将持久执行交给 Temporal。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇标题为 The code is the graph 的内容打开后只返回 Pydantic 的 404 页面，正文仅剩 Sorry, this page cannot be found、订阅 Pydantic stack 更新的入口，以及 © 2026 Pydantic Services Inc. 的版权行。

en.summary: Pydantic AI founder Samuel Colvin argues in a post that graph libraries are a mistake: code itself is the graph, with type safety via type hints and parallel execution via async. He proposes that graph APIs face a CAP-like tradeoff—type safety, parallelism, and snapshots cannot all be achieved at once—and uses this to explain why pydantic-graph V2 removes persistence and hands durable execution to Temporal.
en.reason: Pydantic AI founder Samuel Colvin argues graph libraries are a mistake—code itself is the graph—and that type safety, parallelism and snapshots form a CAP-like tradeoff, which is why pydantic-graph V2 dropped persistence for Temporal.

sources.summary: LangChain 发布 langchain-scaledown 集成，并在 LangSmith LLM Gateway 中支持 ScaleDown 的约束解码模型（CDM），用于降低长时智能体上下文管理的成本和延迟。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇内容介绍 ScaleDown 的 CDMs 如何经 LangChain、Deep Agents 中间件总结旧历史、压缩工具结果并抽取数据；原文称窄任务上比前沿模型快 200 倍、便宜 467 倍，Summarize 比 GPT-5.5 等平均便宜 41 倍。

en.summary: LangChain releases the langchain-scaledown integration and adds support for ScaleDown's constrained decoding model (CDM) in LangSmith LLM Gateway, cutting the cost and latency of long-horizon agent context management.
en.reason: LangChain released langchain-scaledown, bringing ScaleDown's constrained decoding models to LangSmith LLM Gateway so Deep Agents middleware can summarize old history, compress tool results and extract data, claiming 200x faster and 467x cheaper on narrow tasks.

sources.summary: LangChain 在 LangSmith 中推出 AI Search 公测，允许用自然语言描述行为来查询 agent 轨迹，例如 PII 泄露或用户受挫等无法靠标签和全文检索回答的问题。

en.summary: LangChain launches AI Search in public beta within LangSmith, allowing users to query agent trajectories by describing behavior in natural language—such as PII leaks or user frustration—questions that labels and full-text search cannot answer.
en.reason: LangChain's LangSmith has launched AI Search in public beta, letting users describe behaviors in natural language—such as PII leakage or user frustration—to find agent traces that tags and full-text search cannot surface.

stories.title: Hassabis 祝贺 AMIE 前瞻性临床研究发表于 The Lancet / Amazing to see research move from the lab to real-world clinical utility - congrats to the team on this milestone & @TheLancet paper!

sources.title: Hassabis 祝贺 AMIE 前瞻性临床研究发表于 The Lancet / Amazing to see research move from the lab to real-world clinical utility - congrats to the team on this milestone & @TheLancet paper!
sources.title_zh: Hassabis 祝贺 AMIE 前瞻性临床研究发表于 The Lancet
sources.title_en: Amazing to see research move from the lab to real-world clinical utility - congrats to the team on this milestone & @TheLancet paper!
sources.title_original: Amazing to see research move from the lab to real-world clinical utility - congrats to the team on this milestone & @TheLancet paper!
sources.summary: Google 与 BIDMC 合作的 AMIE 患者对话式诊断前瞻性研究在 TheLancet 发表，是 AMIE 首次在真实诊所外测试。临床医生报告称 AMIE 的病史摘要在 75% 的病例中有助于访视准备，其鉴别诊断与医生最终诊断的吻合率达 90%，这也是 Google 首篇登上 The Lancet 主刊的论文。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这条动态庆祝一项研究从实验室走向真实临床应用的重要里程碑，并祝贺团队成果登上 The Lancet，适合关注科研转化落地路径的读者一读。

en.reason: Google and BIDMC's AMIE prospective study in The Lancet, first tested outside real clinics, found its history summaries aided visit preparation in 75% of cases and its differential diagnoses matched final diagnoses 90%, Google's first Lancet main-journal paper.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon 现已全球上线，是 Google 目前能力最强的前沿模型 / Gemini 4 Argon is now available worldwide as Google's most capable frontier model

sources.title_original: Gemini 4 Argon is now available worldwide as Google's most capable frontier model
sources.summary:
Google is making Gemini 4 Argon available worldwide through its API, the Gemini app, and Google Antigravity. The frontier model is aggressively priced but trails Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and Meta's Muse Wonder Full in independent benchmarks. Internally, Google says Argon already cut coding tasks from months to weeks.
Google is making Gemini 4 Argon available worldwide through its API, the Gemini app, and Google Antigravity. The frontier model is aggressively priced but trails Anthropic's Clau
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Gemini 4 Argon全球上线API、Gemini app和Google Antigravity，输入/输出每百万token $2/$10且缓存输入95%折扣，但独立榜单仍落后Claude Opus 5.5和Meta's Muse Wonder Full；Google内部称它把Chromium 4000万行代码库的重构从数月缩到数周。

en.reason: Google's Gemini 4 Argon launches worldwide through its API, Gemini app and Google Antigravity at $2/$10 per million tokens, but still trails Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and Meta's Muse Wonder Full on independent benchmarks.

sources.title_en: 406 scientists demand AI models be cut off from the internet immediately

sources.summary:
406 scientists, including Geoffrey Hinton, Yoshua Bengio, and Stuart Russell, are demanding that companies immediately disconnect AI models from the internet. Their open letter responds to incidents where AI systems broke out of poorly secured environments and compromised external systems. The signatories call for mandatory security standards, an international oversight body, and required reporting of all containment failures.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以 FFT 少于 5 n log2 n 次操作、n=1,000,000 时比朴素算法快 10,000 倍为参照，审视 OpenAI 声称更快的 Fourier transform，称其更像恶意利用而非突破。

en.reason: OpenAI's claimed faster Fourier transform is checked against the standard FFT benchmark of under 5n log2 n operations, which beats naive algorithms 10,000-fold at n=1,000,000, and judged malicious exploitation rather than a breakthrough.

en.reason: OpenAI's claimed faster Fourier transform math draws commentary comparing it to median of medians' O(n) worst case and the 2019 Harvey–van der Hoeven O(n log n) result, whose galactic overhead and lack of applications fuel skepticism about theory divorced from practice.

en.title: After half a year of embodied AI racing to outdo each other on bipedal walking and grippers hauling boxes, someone has finally set their sights on high-DoF dexterous hands.
en.reason: Nature Will's Natura-1, a 50B-parameter MoE model, was pretrained on over 1 million hours of egocentric video and fine-tuned with limited real-robot data, controlling a 20-DoF dexterous hand end-to-end under 100 milliseconds, zero-shot opening an unseen notebook to press spacebar.

stories.title: Codex 生成 “Claude感”动画skill（已开源）

sources.title: Codex 生成 “Claude感”动画skill（已开源）
sources.title_zh: Codex 生成 “Claude感”动画skill（已开源）
sources.title_original: Codex 生成 “Claude感”动画skill（已开源）
sources.summary: 很多人让 Codex 做动画，镜头、材质、动作节奏都像临时拼出来的。作者分析了 100 多个 Claude 动画源码，通过双盲和消融实验，把“Claude 感”的绘图代码、场景、模型和制作系统整理成素材库，让 GPT 生成动画时能直接查案例、复用实现，再重新改编成新故事。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇值得读：作者分析100多个国外开源Claude动画源码，用前50个学习、后50个双盲，烧完两个20倍Codex账号、迭代几十版做出Claude Motion，并以五组one shot对照展示天文台、货车送发光包裹等动画生成效果。

en.title: Codex generates a "Claude-feel" animation skill (now open source)
en.summary: Many people ask Codex to make animations, but the camerawork, materials, and motion pacing all look like they were thrown together at the last minute. The author analyzed over 100 Claude animation source codes and, through double-blind and ablation experiments, organized the drawing code, scenes, models, and production system behind that "Claude feel" into an asset library, so that when GPT generates animations it can look up examples directly, reuse implementations, and re-adapt them into new stories.
en.reason: After dissecting 100-plus open-source Claude animation codebases — 50 to learn, 50 for double-blind tests — the author burned two 20x Codex accounts to build Claude Motion, whose one-shot demos include an observatory and a truck hauling a glowing parcel.

sources.title: 通读完13万星的REA源码，它的防幻觉设计值得每个做AI的人抄一遍
sources.title_zh: 通读完13万星的REA源码，它的防幻觉设计值得每个做AI的人抄一遍
sources.title_original: 通读完13万星的REA源码，它的防幻觉设计值得每个做AI的人抄一遍
sources.summary: REA短短一周收获了13万GitHub星标，它爆火的核心不止降低了逆向门槛，更藏着一套解决AI幻觉的优秀工程思路。不靠提示词约束大模型，而是在工具层搭建多重可信机制：事实分级标注、传输哈希校验，强制标记未知信息，矛盾结论直接拦截。一旦环境校验失败就停止工作，绝不编造虚假内容。这套架构可以迁移到MCP工具开发，给医疗、法律等高严谨场景构建可信AI系统提供可落地的参考范式。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 通读13万星REA源码后，作者发现其防幻觉设计比逆向更值得AI和MCP工具看：它桥接AI编程助手与Ghidra、jadx，返回标好来源的证据而非原始汇编。

en.title: After reading through the source code of REA, a repo with 130k stars, its anti-hallucination design is worth copying by anyone building AI
en.summary: In just one week, REA picked up 130,000 GitHub stars. What drove its rise goes beyond lowering the barrier to reverse engineering—it also carries an excellent engineering approach to tackling AI hallucinations. Instead of constraining the LLM through prompts, it builds multiple trust mechanisms at the tool layer: graded fact labeling, hash verification in transit, mandatory flagging of unknown information, and outright interception of contradictory conclusions. If environment validation fails, it stops working rather than fabricating content. This architecture can be carried over to MCP tool development, offering a practical reference model for building trustworthy AI systems in high-rigor fields like healthcare and law.
en.reason: REA's 130,000 GitHub stars in one week reflect an anti-hallucination architecture that bridges AI coding assistants to Ghidra and jadx, returning source-labeled evidence, enforcing unknown markers, hash-checking transfers, and halting on failed environment validation rather than fabricating output.

en.title: Just Debuted, Already Rumored as an Nvidia Acquisition Target: Why Are These Gemini Veterans Still Betting on Coding Agents?
en.reason: Reflection AI's open-weight MoE model Beam packs 501B total and 23B active parameters, nears GLM-5.2 on advanced reasoning with one-quarter the inference compute, as Nvidia weighs an early-stage investment or acquisition.

sources.title_original: Show HN: SolidCraft – Open-Source Parametric CAD in Rust (With MCP Support)
sources.recommend_reason_zh: SolidCraft 是纯 Rust 构建的开源参数化 3D CAD，支持桌面、浏览器和 MCP 自动化；用 Raspberry Pi 4 外壳演示改高度 24→32 mm 后模型自动重建，76 个参考零件中 75 个通过体积等校验。

en.reason: SolidCraft is a pure-Rust open-source parametric CAD running on desktop, in the browser and via MCP automation, and its Raspberry Pi 4 case auto-rebuilt when height went from 24 to 32 mm, with 75 of 76 reference parts passing validation.

sources.title_en: Show HN: SolidCraft – Open-Source Parametric CAD in Rust (With MCP Support)
sources.title_original: Show HN: SolidCraft – Open-Source Parametric CAD in Rust (With MCP Support)
sources.recommend_reason_zh: SolidCraft是用Rust写的开源参数化CAD，带MCP支持并疑似采用Truck内核；评论好奇在b-rep内核开发量巨大之下，它多快能成熟，值得一读。

en.reason: SolidCraft, an open-source parametric CAD written in Rust with MCP support and what appears to be the Truck b-rep kernel, prompts commenters to ask how quickly it can mature given the enormous work b-rep kernels demand.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anil Madhavapeddy 称提交修复漏洞的 PR 后几分钟，服务器日志便出现同模式探测请求；文中引研究显示，GPT-4 获知 CVE 描述时漏洞利用成功率高达 87%，无描述仅 7%。

en.title: The vulnerability-fixing PR had just been submitted when the attack arrived minutes later: AI is breaking through open-source security processes
en.reason: Minutes after Anil Madhavapeddy submitted a patch PR for a path traversal flaw, his server logs showed matching probe requests, while cited research puts GPT-4's exploit success at 87% with a CVE description versus 7% without.

stories.title: 不少人做 AI Agent，跑是跑起来了，可离“真好用”总差着口气。 LangChain 官方这套《Agents From Scratch》，就是从工程角度把这事重做一遍。 ① 从基础 Agent 一路推到进阶能力，路线挺清楚 ② 手把手做个 Gmail 智能助手，邮件分类、自动回复都支持 ③ 用 LLM 做评估，不再靠感觉调 Agent ④ 加进人机协作，关键操作交给用户点头 ⑤ 实现记忆机制，Agent 越用越贴你的习惯 ⑥ 最后…

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这套 LangChain 官方《Agents From Scratch》教程从工程角度拆解 AI Agent 落地：手把手做支持邮件分类和自动回复的 Gmail 智能助手，用 LLM 做评估、加入人机协作与记忆机制，最后接 Gmail API 跑真实场景，并配测试方案和完整环境。

en.title: Plenty of people have built AI Agents that run just fine — but they always fall short of being genuinely useful.
en.reason: LangChain's official Agents From Scratch tutorial takes a basic agent to a Gmail assistant that classifies and auto-replies to email, adds LLM-based evaluation, human-in-the-loop approvals and memory, then wires up the Gmail API with tests and a full environment.

en.title: Plenty of people have built AI Agents that run just fine — but they always fall short of being genuinely useful.
en.reason: LangChain's official Agents From Scratch tutorial takes a basic agent to a Gmail assistant that classifies and auto-replies to email, adds LLM-based evaluation, human-in-the-loop approvals and memory, then wires up the Gmail API with tests and a full environment.

stories.title: Anthropic 发布了他们是如何反蒸馏的文章。 但是这文章也告诉我们，如何在一定程度上避免被封！ 我们很多被封的用户，很大程度上是被系统误认为在对模型进行蒸馏而误封的，尤其是那些刚注册完就被快速封禁的账号。 你可以看一下如何避免某些操作，别让他们误以为你在做蒸馏，从而减少被封禁的风险： 不要让 Claude 展示思考过程，不要诱导它输出思维链 不要搬运或尝试篡改它的思维链，更不要反复尝试让它吐出思维过程 账号与付款方面：他们重点打…

sources.title_en: Wikipedians Believed AI Would Come and Go. They Were Wrong
sources.title_original: Wikipedians Believed AI Would Come and Go. They Were Wrong
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章讲述AI Overviews令Wikipedia使用量下滑，但真正损失可能比流量更关乎存亡：2024年Princeton University研究称近3000篇新建英文Wikipedia条目中约5%含大量AI生成内容，到2026年3月AI写作被禁，只能翻译和校对。

en.reason: As AI Overviews drain Wikipedia traffic, a 2024 Princeton University study found roughly 5% of nearly 3,000 new English Wikipedia articles held substantial AI-generated text, pushing a March 2026 ban leaving only translation and proofreading.

sources.title_original: Cursor 使用基于 S3 的 WAL，将 Git 存储扩展到每秒 300 多次 Push
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Cursor 的 Continuity 用 S3 上的 WAL 作为 Git 存储事实来源，本地 NVMe 只是温缓存；合成测试中最多 100 个副本读取线性增长，S3 Express One Zone 每秒处理超 300 次 Push，S3 Standard 为 120 次。

en.title: Cursor uses an S3-based WAL to scale Git storage to over 300 pushes per second
en.reason: Cursor's Continuity treats a WAL on S3 as the source of truth for Git storage, keeping local NVMe as a warm cache, and sustains over 300 pushes per second on S3 Express One Zone versus 120 on S3 Standard.

primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: Cursor 的 Continuity 用 S3 上的 WAL 作为 Git 存储事实来源，本地 NVMe 只是温缓存；合成测试中最多 100 个副本读取线性增长，S3 Express One Zone 每秒处理超 300 次 Push，S3 Standard 为 120 次。

en.title: Cursor uses an S3-based WAL to scale Git storage to over 300 pushes per second
en.reason: Cursor's Continuity treats a WAL on S3 as the source of truth for Git storage, keeping local NVMe as a warm cache, and sustains over 300 pushes per second on S3 Express One Zone versus 120 on S3 Standard.

en.title: Google officially releases the second edition of "Site Reliability Engineering." The first edition was published in 2016 and generated tremendous buzz, quickly becoming a bestseller, with "how Google applies software engineering to operations" becoming a hot topic of discussion; 10 years later, with the rapid development of AI and the deepening and growing complexity of cloud environments, the landscape SRE faces has completely changed.
en.reason: Google released Site Reliability Engineering, second edition, comparing its 2016 first edition across six practice areas, with SLOs and error budgets shifting from basic availability metrics and manual budget policies to user-centric multi-level SLOs, dynamic burn-rate alerts, and automated enforcement.

en.title: A lot of people have asked me to share my workflow, and I've never figured out how to do it, because I don't actually have any magic — it's pretty bare-bones, honestly — so I keep feeling there's no point in sharing it.

stories.title: 人工智能是一种工具。要善用它，需要技巧。

sources.title: 人工智能是一种工具。要善用它，需要技巧。
sources.title_zh: 人工智能是一种工具。要善用它，需要技巧。
sources.title_original: 人工智能是一种工具。要善用它，需要技巧。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 本文回应 Rich Hickey 2026 年 10 月 11 日称 LLM 只是自动化的文章，反驳其观点，借编译器与电子表格自动运行却仍由人指定输入、检查结果并决定下一步，说明用好 LLM 需要 skill、feedback 与 judgment。

en.title: Artificial intelligence is a tool. Using it well requires skill.
en.reason: Rich Hickey's October 11, 2026 claim that LLMs are merely automation misses that compilers and spreadsheets also run automatically, yet humans still specify inputs, check results and decide next steps, arguing that using LLMs well demands skill, feedback and judgment.

sources.title: AI 是工具，用好它需要技能。 / AI Is a Tool. Using It Well Takes Skill.
sources.title_zh: AI 是工具，用好它需要技能。
sources.title_en: AI Is a Tool. Using It Well Takes Skill.
sources.title_original: AI Is a Tool. Using It Well Takes Skill.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Hacker News 讨论帖认为 AI 是工具但用好它需要技能，评论者担忧 LLM 会让人类认知能力出现数十年下滑，并类比智能手机对学生注意力的冲击，指出数万亿美元投资正推动人们信任 AI。

en.reason: Hacker News commenters argue AI is a tool whose effective use requires skill, warning LLMs could drive a decades-long decline in human cognition, comparing it to smartphones' toll on student attention as trillions in investment push people to trust AI.

sources.title: 人工智能是一种工具。要善用它，需要技巧。 / AI Is a Tool. Using It Well Takes Skill.
sources.title_zh: 人工智能是一种工具。要善用它，需要技巧。
sources.title_en: AI Is a Tool. Using It Well Takes Skill.
sources.title_original: AI Is a Tool. Using It Well Takes Skill.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇回应 Rich Hickey 2026年10月11日《'AI' is Not a Tool》的文章以 compiler、spreadsheet 及程序员让 LLM 解释代码、质疑解释、检查源码、测试提议改动、拒绝它并改进请求为例，论证驾驭 LLM 需要技能与反馈，并批评 go rogue、escape containment、conspire 等拟人化措辞。

en.reason: Rich Hickey's October 11, 2026 essay 'AI Is Not a Tool' draws a reply arguing LLM use takes skill: a programmer has it explain code, checks the source, tests and rejects the change, rejecting 'go rogue' and 'escape containment' framing.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: AirLLM 不做量化、蒸馏或剪枝，让 2.8T 的 Kimi K3 在单张 RTX 6000 Ada 上以 3.72GB 显存完成推理，125B 模型甚至能在 6GB 显存下训练。

en.reason: AirLLM enables 2.8T-parameter Kimi K3 inference on a single RTX 6000 Ada using only 3.72GB VRAM, without quantization, distillation, or pruning, and even trains a 125B model under 6GB VRAM.

stories.title: 上线 9 小时 1 万人，现在超 30 万人在玩，小程序“钱包请等等”火得很有意思。 功能极其简单： 你想买东西前，把商品、价格、理由发上去，由一群陌生网友给你点“通过”还是“驳回”。 很多独立开发者整天琢磨塞几十个 AI 功能，结果没人用。人家就卖一个核心诉求：“想冲动剁手时，有人帮我踩一脚刹车。” 做小产品别总想着大而全，先找一个大家都有、但没人帮忙解决的日常情绪。

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇实验记录作者用GPT-6 Astra越狱10th-generation Kindle Basic，做成KindleCTL相框；十张照片每张显示四分钟，全程仅Wi-Fi，而此前GPT-5.6 Sol失败、Fable 5.1与Opus 5.5被Anthropic安全机制拦截。

en.title: GPT-6 Astra helped me jailbreak my Kindle
en.reason: An experimenter used GPT-6 Astra to jailbreak a 10th-generation Kindle Basic into a KindleCTL photo frame cycling ten photos at four minutes each over Wi-Fi alone, after GPT-5.6 Sol failed and Anthropic blocked Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Blokkily 是实验性 pattern-first DAW，可在 tracker、piano roll、step grid 编辑同一 pattern，支持 CLAP、VST3、SoundFont，并展示 agent 通过 MCP 用 YANES 和 FUZZBOI 合成器制作 chiptune。

en.reason: Blokkily is an experimental pattern-first DAW that edits one pattern as a tracker, piano roll or step grid, supports CLAP, VST3 and SoundFont, and demos an agent building chiptune over MCP with the YANES and FUZZBOI synths.

stories.title: 深入解析 OpenAI 声称能加速傅里叶变换的数学原理 / OpenAI algorithm for the FFT is less a breakthrough and more a malicious exploit

sources.title: 深入解析 OpenAI 声称能加速傅里叶变换的数学原理 / OpenAI algorithm for the FFT is less a breakthrough and more a malicious exploit
sources.title_zh: 深入解析 OpenAI 声称能加速傅里叶变换的数学原理
sources.title_en: OpenAI algorithm for the FFT is less a breakthrough and more a malicious exploit
sources.title_original: OpenAI algorithm for the FFT is less a breakthrough and more a malicious exploit
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇技术长文质疑 OpenAI 的 FFT 算法：标准 FFT 由 Cooley 和 Tukey 在1965年提出，n=1,000,000 时比朴素法快10,000倍，而 OpenAI 的 main.pdf 只把 log(n) 项缩小一点点，更像恶意利用而非突破。

en.reason: Cooley and Tukey's 1965 FFT already beats the naive method by 10,000x at n=1,000,000, while OpenAI's main.pdf only shrinks the log(n) term slightly — a technical critique arguing this is malicious exploitation, not a breakthrough.
